title: Connecticut Railroad Historical Museum

services.name: Pumpkin Patch Express
services.desc: Experience the views and colors of autumn throughout the Litchfield Hills on our Pumpkin Patch Trains! These special excursions run along the beautiful Naugatuck River, crossing several bridges allowing for spectacular views of the river and surrounding scenery. Visitors will enjoy a dish of pumpkin ice cream from the Nutmeg Fudge Co. The Pumpkin Patch Express will stop at the Naugatuck Railroad's very own pumpkin patch. Here, passengers are able to select their very own pumpkin to bring home. This ride is very popular, especially among younger kids and runs in the weeks leading up to Halloween. The ride lasts about an hour. The Nutmeg Fudge Co will be at Thomaston Station selling local

services.name: Chocolate Decadence Tour
services.desc: Back by popular demand for 2026 in partnership with the Naugatuck Railroad, Railroad Museum of New England, Uncommon Grill, and Fascia’s Chocolates The event begins at the historic 1881 Thomaston Station where passengers will board our new hi level railcars. The train will depart and stop on the spectacular Thomaston Dam on its way to Fascia’s Chocolates where you will make your own chocolate creations. During the trip Fascia’s will don an interactive chocolate pairings onboard, Featuring local Guest Host Wineries that won’t disappoint! Please note, this event is for adults ages 21 and over. ALL guests must present a valid ID when boarding the train, regardless of age.** Please Note:

services.name: Charters & Groups
services.desc: In addition to normally scheduled trains, the Railroad Museum of New England is proud to also offer charters upon request! Whether your group is big or small, we can help fill your needs and provide you with a venue like no other. You have the option to book our historic Thomaston Station, or charter your very own private train ride pulled by one of our vintage diesel locomotives.
